create_CustomPoseVisualizationHook: create a CustomPoseVisualizationHook instance to visualize pose estimation predictions during training
run_after_train_iter: run the after_train_iter hook to save heatmaps and joint visualizations at set intervals
save_batch_heatmaps: save a grid of batch heatmaps with predicted keypoints overlaid on images to a file
save_batch_image_with_joints: save a grid of images with COCO keypoints and skeleton connections drawn on top
vis_keypoints: visualize COCO keypoints and skeleton connections on a BGR image using OpenCV drawing
